title: Copy Text Margins (VisualElements)

scenarios.title: Copy Text Margins applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Copy Text Margins (BtnLearnMargin) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Copy Text Margins stages the real TextFrame margins in real PowerPoint
scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the deployed Copy Text Margins on one selected text box staged at Left=17 Right=19 Top=21 Bottom=23 shows its success info box (the driver measures dialogSeen=True and dismisses with a synthetic key press) and populates the production MarginState with exactly those values (measured stateMatch=True learnedLeft=17), returns true, writes no new entry in the oPenEfficiency error log of the run day, and leaves the host stable.
